remarksWeb: Please note that the Company allotted 14,76,432 Equity shares on June 23, 2026, comprising of 2,42,855 Equity shares under ESOP Scheme 2020 and 12,33,577 Equity shares under ESOP Scheme 2024. However, these allotted shares are not reflecting in the listed capital or in the dematerialised holding with Depositories on June 30, 2026 as the corporate action was underway. Further, the Corporate Action was completed on July 09, 2026 and listing & trading approvals were received on these shares from NSE & BSE on July 09, 2026. The Company has included these allotted shares in the current shareholding pattern.
